$comment: #EXP-1804 THE CI RUN PAGE AND RUNNER SECTION AS genUI TREES, the same on every platform (ci-run.json and runner-settings.json say what; this pins HOW, node for node). `ciRun`: inputs of the run page builder (`model` {run, jobs with runnerLabel and steps}, `selected` job id, `log` = the selected job's log as read so far (null = not read), `now`, `phone`, `busy` = the button in flight: rerun | rerunAll | cancel | null, `jobOpen` = a phone drilled into the selected job; #EXP-2172 (the approved redesign): the model also carries the run's title, createdAt, ref, provider, externalUrl, externalAccess, the repository's full name, the PR {number, base} and the author's name) → `tree` (A2UI nested nodes: id, component, props, children, slots, on). `runner`: the runner section (`client`, `caps`, `kind` = the device's desktop | server, `platform`, `settings`, `owner`, `refused` = the last labels entry was refused, `recent` true = the rows of runner-settings.json recentJobs[0]) → `tree`. `after`: a control event of the section (`event` id, `payload`) on `current` settings → the `settings` to write (null = nothing to write) and `refused`. The reference is apps/web/src/lib/ci-run-view.ts (its test replays this file); desktop, iOS and Android build the same trees. Regenerate after a deliberate change with `bun apps/web/scripts/bless-ci-run-view.ts` and review the diff. #EXP-2214: the model may carry `context` (ci-page.json `ciRunContext`): its kind Badge leads the chip strip, a merge queue run's title falls back to its batch title, and its What happened Section (`ci-run-outcome`) sits under the bar; ci-open-pr {pr} opens a PR, Open log fires ci-select-job {job}.
